shared_elements: tall upright slab/stele carved in low relief
content organised into stacked horizontal registers
a horizontal band of repeated small units running across the upper part
row of similar repeated figures side by side in the top register
small schematic profile figures/signs filling the field
vertically hanging fringe-like strokes below a band
justification: Both are tall upright slabs whose surface is divided into stacked horizontal registers, each containing a row of repeated schematic low-relief figures, and both include a narrow band with short pendant strokes beneath it separating registers. But the depicted subjects differ fundamentally: A shows standing anthropomorphic figures with raised arms, hands and held objects amid small signs, while B shows animals in profile (quadrupeds, a long-necked bird, a serpentine creature) with no human actors or object-holding relationships.
